title: Kummer degree functionals in a flat family of possibly nonreduced curves
statement:
Let $c:C\to S$ be separated, flat, of finite presentation and compactifiable between Noetherian schemes, with every nonempty geometric fibre purely one-dimensional [def-weil-pure-dimension] [def-weil-flat-morphism], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], [def-asd-compactifiable]. Let $N\geq1$ be invertible on $S$, let $R=\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z$, and let $F$ be a sheaf of $R$-modules on $S_{\mathrm{et}}$. Use the ordinary etale compact-support functor and $F(1)=F\otimes_R\mu_N$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. For a geometric point $\bar s$ and the finite set $I_{\bar s}$ of irreducible components of $C_{\bar s}$, there is a canonical Kummer degree isomorphism
$$H_c^2(C_{\bar s},F_{\bar s}(1))\cong\bigoplus_{i\in I_{\bar s}}F_{\bar s}.$$
It is normalized by degree of line bundles on a proper completion of the reduced components [def-pc-degree-line-bundle]; the Kummer Chern class and projective-line normalization have the meaning in [def-amb-p1-trace]. Write $m_i$ for the length of the Artinian local ring of $C_{\bar s}$ at the generic point of component $i$. Under compact-support base change, the functionals $(a_i)_i\mapsto\sum_i m_i a_i$ on the geometric stalks of $R^2c_!c^*F(1)$ are the stalks of a unique $R$-linear sheaf morphism $\delta_{c,F}:R^2c_!c^*F(1)\to F$. This formation is natural in $F$, commutes with change of Noetherian base and with passage from $N'$ to $N$ for $N\mid N'$ with $N'$ invertible on $S$, under $\mu_{N'}\to\mu_N$, $z\mapsto z^{N'/N}$, and restricts along open immersions by extension by zero.

For a separated quasi-finite flat finitely presented $u:C'\to C$, the functionals satisfy $\delta_{cu,F}=\delta_{c,F}\circ R^2c_!(\tau_{u,c^*F(1)})$, where $\tau$ is the weighted sum of [lem-pur-quasifinite-flat-weighted-trace]. For a Noetherian scheme $T$ and a separated quasi-finite flat finitely presented $v:S\to T$ with $vc$ compactifiable and $N$ invertible on $T$, they also satisfy $\delta_{vc,F}=\tau_{v,F}\circ v_!(\delta_{c,v^*F})$ for every $R$-module sheaf $F$ on $T$, under the canonical composition identifications. For $c:\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ and $F=R_S$, the functional sends the Kummer Chern class of $\mathcal O(1)$ to $1$.

Here a Noetherian scheme admits a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings, and a ring is Noetherian when every ideal is finitely generated [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring].
